verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs say its AI gateway has been open sourced and can be run locally via npx, and the guardrails page refers to the 'open-source Gateway'. Only the gateway component is described as open, though, while the wider platform (logs, model catalog, guardrails layer) appears to be built on top of it with no openness claim, and no license or repository is named. Missing for 10: named open-source license, link to the public source repository, evidence that the full product beyond the gateway is open, independent confirmation the source is readable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: We've open sourced our battle-tested AI gateway to the community.
Portkey runs 60+ powerful AI guardrails on top of the open-source Gateway
